clips.prompt_ir: Locked 35mm-equivalent overhead three-quarter view of a 1950s walnut tabletop radio, heavily rusted and dusty, on a scarred oak bench. Callused hands in denim cuff place it from screen left; knob resists. Cool dusty fill, lamp upper right, chipped green mug lower left. End dust fall and three dull clicks.

Exact same composition. Brass brush sweeps grille left-to-right; cloth lifts grime; rear screws loosen. Preserve lamp, mug, bench grain, hands and lens. Exterior visibly cleaner, open back revealed. Workshop tone and brighter two-note ring; no captions.

Exact same composition. Solder bridges broken lead, capacitor seats, fingertip taps cone. Amber solder glow pivots attention; taut cream cloth replaces corrosion. Locked camera. Sizzle follows motif and ends faint static breath.

Exact same composition. Amber oil spreads walnut, knobs return, screws tighten clockwise. Warm sheen grows while landmarks stay fixed. Tungsten lamp warms. Clean plucked three-note motif syncs to turns. No text.

Exact same composition, fully reassembled radio. Cord enters left, plug seats, dial lamp blooms gold, needle moves as hand turns knob. Speaker cloth vibrates and clear human weather bulletin emerges. Resolve motif into station ident. No subtitles or logos.
